items.title: Wabi-Sabi
items.definition: Beauty found in imperfection, incompletion, and weathered transience.
items.core_meaning: Accept fracture as identity rather than flaw.
items.visual_translation: Cracked porcelain, asymmetry, restrained ornament, tactile wear.
items.composition_effect: Asymmetric balance with intentional negative gaps.
items.material_effect: Ceramic, paper, oxidized metal, worn lacquer.
items.lighting_effect: Soft directional light with subtle falloff and shadow texture.
items.source_note: Curated synthesis from Japanese aesthetics references used in studio direction.
items.why_selected: Directly maps to Mikage fracture/porcelain identity.
items.teaches: How imperfection can become premium visual language.

items.title: Ma
items.definition: Intentional interval or pause in space/time that gives form meaning.
items.core_meaning: Silence and emptiness are active design elements.
items.visual_translation: Large negative space, sparse staging, controlled object count.
items.composition_effect: High breathing room around subject with strict hierarchy.
items.material_effect: Plain surfaces, matte finishes, minimal clutter.
items.lighting_effect: Low-noise, controlled key light with restrained highlights.
items.source_note: Curated from Japanese design principles and spatial composition theory.
items.why_selected: Supports Neo-Tokyo silence over generic noise.
items.teaches: How emptiness drives focus and emotional weight.

items.title: Mono no Aware
items.definition: Awareness of impermanence and gentle sadness at passing beauty.
items.visual_translation: Fading light, delicate materials, melancholic stillness.
items.composition_effect: Lingering, contemplative framing with restrained movement.
items.material_effect: Translucent fabrics, weathered surfaces, fragile textures.
items.lighting_effect: Twilight tonal range and soft luminous edges.
items.source_note: Curated from Japanese literary and visual sensibility references.
items.teaches: How to express emotional subtlety without melodrama.
